description: Active Protective has developed the Tango Belt, the first smart belt which deploys wearable airbags in the event of a fall. The belt detects a fall in progress with great accuracy and deploys airbags over the hips to attenuate the impact of the fall. Beyond hip protection, the belt promotes safe mobility to help older adults remain/regain confidence and independence.

description: CareLinx is a nationwide professional caregiver marketplace, which empowers families to easily find, hire, manage and pay licensed caregivers online. CareLinx was acquired by Generali Global Assistance in September 2017.

Caremerge provides senior living communities with an all-in-one EHR and engagement platform for staff, residents and families. The system features four core modules: Care Coordination, Family Engagement, Community Engagement and Calendar Central.

CarePort Health improves post-acute outcomes by providing solutions to guide patients to high-quality providers upon discharge and to track patients – and results – in real-time across the continuum. CarePort Health was acquired by Allscripts in October 2016.

description: Datma facilitates precision medicine through custom-built data store technologies and causal AI. The company’s framework enables for the organization, integration, and analysis of siloed healthcare data. Providers can use Datma’s technology to create, for example, a precise treatment plan for a cancer patient based on his or her genetic profile and health history.

Ellipsis Health has developed a voice-based biomarker for behavioral health. With 2-3 minutes of speech, Ellipsis can screen for depression and anxiety in real-time. This vital sign enables providers to better identify these conditions and monitor at-risk patients.

description: IntelyCare is an on-demand staffing solution for post-acute care providers. Their nurse staffing marketplace and powerful workforce management software help to optimize existing talent while lowering costs by reducing turnover and compliance penalties. For nurses, IntelyCare offers access to flexible, on-demand staffing opportunities and intelligently matches them to open shifts that providers need filled.

Post Acute Analytics provides an end-to-end solution for at-risk providers and payers to monitor, coordinate and intervene on patients’ post-acute care, ensuring the highest quality of care at the lowest cost. Their turnkey integration engine and predictive analytics/reporting provide accurate, timely, actionable data to drive care pathways.

Third Eye Health’s mission is to prevent unnecessary hospitalizations for post-acute and long term care patients. Third Eye Health leverages its mobile-first telehealth technology and nationwide physician practice with post acute expertise to bring the best care to the bedside within two minutes - 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

True Link is a financial services firm dedicated to protecting and increasing the independence and quality of life of its customers. The company offers a range of payment, investment and insurance products catered to the needs of older adults.
